docs.title: Documentation

gettingStarted.title: Connect your account
gettingStarted.body: Sign in with a wallet used by your organization. Your wallet asks you to sign a login message; signing in does not send a payment. In Settings, link your existing Safe funding account. The account owners and signature threshold control payments. Never share a recovery phrase or private key with your team or support.

recipients.title: Import recipients and payout instructions
recipients.body: Open Recipients and choose Import. Paste or upload a CSV export, then map name, email, wallet address, currency and network. Review duplicates and incomplete rows before saving. Records can be imported without an address, but every recipient needs complete payout details before a payment can be prepared. Payroll exports usually need these payout details added separately.

workflows.title: Prepare one payment or a batch
workflows.body: Choose New payment and select saved recipients. Enter the exact amount each person should receive. Saved payout instructions determine their currency, network and address. Different currencies or networks produce separate batches, each with its own approval and settlement. Saving a draft does not move funds.

bills.title: Pay a vendor bill
bills.body: Record the vendor, invoice number, amount and due date in Bills. Prepare its payment from the bill so the records stay linked. A bill becomes paid only after its linked payment has verified settlement.

approvals.title: Review and approve
approvals.body: Open the payment to review recipients, amounts, funding account and the separate fee. Account owners sign in their wallets. Disburse shows the required approvals and checks them before submitting. An eligible member can use a granted spending allowance instead; a delegated batch requests a signature for each recipient and one for the fee.

schedules.title: Schedule and repeat payments
schedules.body: Choose a future pay date and complete approvals beforehand. When configured, the payment service submits eligible scheduled payments when due. Recurring instructions prepare a new draft for each cycle; each draft needs fresh review and authorization. Review paused instructions when recipient details or permissions change. Cancelling an instruction does not invalidate a proposal already signed in Safe.

fees.title: Understand amounts and fees
fees.body: Recipients receive the amounts you entered. The reviewed payment fee is added separately to the account debit and counts toward spending limits. A fee in another currency requires a balance and, for delegated payments, an allowance in that currency. Supported managed payment flows do not require the member to broadcast a native-gas transaction.

recovery.title: Resolve a payment needing attention
recovery.body: Open Payments and choose Needs attention. Check settlement verifies the original submission without sending it again. Resume only when the app confirms it can retry the original authorization. Avoid preparing a replacement while the original outcome is uncertain. Receipt linking can reconcile an existing delegated payment even when new payments are blocked.

billing.title: Trial, renewal and access
billing.body: The trial includes 30 days of Pro. After it ends, Free features apply: you can continue managing your funds and sending payments, paying your own fees. Paid subscriptions cover 30 days and do not renew automatically. Renew in Settings, under Plan & billing. If checkout was interrupted, verify the saved receipt before paying again. Your funds stay in your Safe.

reports.title: Reconcile your records
reports.body: Reports shows incoming funds, outgoing payments, fees and net change separately for each currency. Filter before exporting and check the stated export scope. Payments exports include recipient totals and fees; transaction references let your team match records to settlement.
